parameters.query: SELECT id, url, name, expected_response, timeout_seconds, failure_threshold, current_failure_count, priority, check_interval_minutes, expected_response_chars, http_method FROM monitored_urls WHERE is_active = TRUE AND (last_checked_at IS NULL OR last_checked_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL check_interval_minutes MINUTE)) ORDER BY FIELD(priority, 'critical', 'high', 'normal', 'low'), last_checked_at ASC LIMIT 10;
